title: AI Expense Watchdog
tagline: Find cost leaks hiding in your business.
summary: Scans expenses, subscriptions, vendor payments, and credit card transactions to flag unusual increases, duplicate tools, and potential savings.
businessProblem: SMBs accumulate SaaS subscriptions, vendor creep, and duplicate tools over years — nobody audits spending until margins compress unexpectedly.
outcome: Monthly expense audit report flagging: new recurring charges, price increases >10%, duplicate software, unused subscriptions, and estimated monthly savings if addressed.
whoItsFor: Owners who haven't reviewed expenses line-by-line in 6+ months and suspect they're paying for tools nobody uses.
aiInputs: 90 days credit card and bank transactions
Prior month expense categories for comparison
Known essential vs discretionary vendor list
Employee count for per-seat SaaS sanity check
aiOutputs: Duplicate tool categories (e.g., two project management apps)
Prioritized action list with cancellation difficulty rating
noCodeTools: Ramp or Brex spend report + GPT analysis
Monthly spreadsheet review ritual with Claude
lowCodeTools: n8n monthly: Plaid transactions → OpenAI categorization → report
Zapier + QBO expense sync + GPT flagging
Google Sheets expense log with GPT anomaly column
customBuildStack: OpenAI for vendor grouping and duplicate detection
Monthly email report with savings estimate
implementationSteps: Connect bank/credit card via Plaid or accounting export
Run first-month baseline to catalog all recurring charges
Tag essential vs discretionary vendors with owner
Set alert thresholds for MoM increases
Review monthly report and action top 3 savings items
Re-run quarterly for vendor contract renewal timing
systemBehavior: Compares to prior periods, not arbitrary benchmarks
Savings estimates are directional, not guaranteed
risks: False positives on legitimate one-time purchases
Cancelling wrong subscription can disrupt operations
Shared vendor accounts may look like duplicates
Not a substitute for accountant-led expense review
